datasets.title: Madagascar Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Madagascar Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/madagascar_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Madagascar administrative units during 2021, classifying acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Results were spatially encoded as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) with IPC phase classifications, collection dates, and scenario information to document the evolving food security crisis.
